title: How Do Novice Describers Edit AI Drafts? The Role of Draft Quality in Audio Description Authoring
abstract: arXiv:2605.05348v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Audio description (AD) narrates visual elements in video for blind and low-vision audiences. Recent work has shown that giving novice describers an AI-generated draft to start from helps produce higher-quality AD and lowers the barrier to entry. What remains an open question is how draft quality shapes the editing process. We investigate this through GenAD, an AD generation pipeline that incorporates accessibility guidelines and contextual video information, and RefineAD, an editing interface for human revisions. Human-AI contributions are measured across text, timing, and delivery. In a within-subjects study, we compared authoring from scratch against editing AI drafts of varying quality. GenAD drafts cut completion time by more than half and significantly reduced cognitive load. In contrast, baseline drafts generated from simple, unguided prompts offered only modest benefits, pointing to a minimum quality threshold for effect

translated_title: 新手描述者如何编辑AI草稿？草稿质量在音频描述创作中的作用
translated_abstract: 音频描述（AD）是为盲人和低视力观众讲述视频中视觉元素的技术。最近的研究表明，为新手描述者提供AI生成的草稿作为起点，有助于产出更高质量的音频描述，并降低了入门门槛。然而，草稿质量如何影响编辑过程仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们通过GenAD（一个融合无障碍指南和上下文视频信息的音频描述生成流水线）和RefineAD（一个支持人工修订的编辑界面）来研究这一问题。人机贡献从文本、时间和表达方式三个维度进行衡量。在一项被试内研究中，我们比较了从零创作与编辑不同质量的AI草稿两种方式。结果显示，GenAD草稿将完成时间缩短了一半以上，并显著降低了认知负荷。相比之下，由简单、无引导的提示生成的基线草稿仅带来有限的益处，这表明AI草稿要发挥作用存在一个最低质量阈值。
tldr: 研究发现AI草稿质量对音频描述创作至关重要：高质量的GenAD草稿可将完成时间缩短一半以上并显著降低认知负荷，而低质量草稿收益有限，表明存在一个发挥效用的最低质量阈值。
en_tdlr: Draft quality is critical in AI-assisted audio description authoring: high-quality GenAD drafts cut completion time by more than half and reduced cognitive load, while low-quality drafts offered only modest benefits, revealing a minimum quality threshold for AI drafts to be effective.
